input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that tariffs had no effect on P&G's gross margin in fiscal 2026. However, multiple pieces of evidence from P&G's fiscal 2026 quarterly filings (10-Q forms filed in January 2026 and April 2026) explicitly contradict this claim. Evidence E1 through E6 all document gross margin declines across various business segments during fiscal 2026, and each passage explicitly identifies "higher cost of tariffs" or "higher tariffs costs" as one of the drivers of these gross margin declines. The evidence covers multiple quarters and business segments within fiscal 2026, consistently showing that tariffs negatively impacted gross margins. Therefore, the claim is directly contradicted by the filing evidence.
